info.name: LoanLens API - Egyptian Loan Financial Advisor (Bilingual EN/AR)
info.description:
Postman Collection for LoanLens Financial Advisory Engine.
- Dual Language Support: English (Default) & Arabic (switch `lang` variable to `ar`).
- OpenAPI Spec URL: http://localhost:5257/openapi/v1.json
- Scalar Interactive UI: http://localhost:5257/scalar/v1

item.name: 1. Authentication & Users
item.description: User registration, authentication, JWT tokens, and user profile management.

request.description: Registers a new user and issues a JWT token.
Logs in with the seeded System Administrator account and automatically updates {{authToken}}.
Logs in as a standard borrower user and saves token to {{authToken}}.
Fetches profile, roles, and scenario count for currently authenticated token.

item.name: 2. Admin Management & Dashboard
item.description: Executive dashboard metrics, user account management, and system-wide scenario administration.

request.description: Returns full website metrics: total users, active/inactive counts, scenario volume, total principal simulated, average DTI, CBE rates, and recent activity.
Admin only: Lists all platform users with role, status, creation date, and scenario counts.

item.name: 3. Get User Details & History by ID

request.description: Admin only: Gets full profile and saved scenario history for a specific user ID.
Admin only: Updates user name, email, role (promotes to Admin/demotes to User), active status, or resets password.
Admin only: Deletes a user account from PostgreSQL.
Admin only: Lists all scenarios across all users in the system.
Admin only: Deletes any scenario in the database by ID.

item.name: 3. Egyptian Banking Market Rates
item.description: Live and benchmark Egyptian banking market rates, CBE corridor rates, and admin refresh.

item.name: 1. Get Live CBE Corridor & Benchmark Bank Rates

request.description: Public: Returns CBE Corridor (Lending 28.25%, Deposit 27.25%, Main Operation 27.75%) and benchmark rates from top Egyptian banks (NBE, Banque Misr, CIB, QNB, AAIB). Cached in Redis.
Admin only: Forces cache invalidation and re-computes market rate averages.

item.name: 3. Live Scrape Egyptian Bank Rates via AngleSharp (Admin)

request.description: Admin only: Executes AngleSharp HTML5 web crawler across CBE official policy portals and Egyptian retail bank pages, parses live interest rates, updates Redis cache, and returns detailed scrape diagnostic metrics.

item.name: 4. Core Financial Engines & Calculator
item.description: Pure calculation engines: amortization, affordability (DTI), stress testing, Monte Carlo, and capacity.

request.description: Executes full pipeline: Amortization Schedule, Affordability (DTI), 7 Stress Shocks, 5000-path Monte Carlo, 0-100 Risk Score, Strategy Options, and Market Catalog Comparison. Returns English by default or Arabic when lang=ar.
Calculates monthly installment and schedule. Converts Flat rate (12%) to Effective APR (e.g. ~21.5%).
Evaluates DTI ratio against CBE 50% threshold, disposable cash flow, and emergency runway months.
Simulates 7 deterministic crisis scenarios: Medical emergency, 1/3/6 months job interruption, 25% income loss, inflation/rate hike, and combined crisis.
Runs 5,000 stochastic life simulations with Gaussian income volatility and Poisson emergency events. Supports tunable custom volatility, shock probability, and emergency cost.
Retrieves catalog of commercial bank loans and consumer finance products in English (default) or Arabic (lang=ar).
Calculates maximum loan amount and installment under Egyptian Central Bank (CBE) 50% legal limit vs 35% safe recommended ceiling. Factors in borrower retirement age and existing debt obligations.

item.name: 16. Variable Rate & CBE Corridor Sensitivity Simulation

item.name: 5. Scenario Persistence & Management
item.description: Save, list, reload, compare, and delete evaluated loan scenarios.

request.description: Saves analysis scenario into SQLite database and sets the scenarioId collection variable for subsequent queries.
Lists recently saved loan scenarios with key indicators (Risk Score, DTI, Installment, Verdict).
Retrieves full saved analysis report JSON by GUID ID.
Loads two previously saved scenarios by GUID IDs from SQLite and performs a full side-by-side comparative analysis.

item.name: 10. Download Saved Scenario PDF by ID

item.name: 18. Download Saved Scenario Excel by ID

item.name: 20. Get Saved Scenario AI Narrative Advice by ID

item.name: 6. Reports & AI Exports
item.description: Vector PDF export, formatted Excel (.xlsx) workbooks, and standalone AI advisory narratives.

item.name: 7. Realistic Egyptian Scenarios (Ready-to-Test)
item.description: Real-world test scenarios reflecting typical Egyptian household incomes and borrowing requests.

item.name: Scenario 1: Safe Profile - Stable Corporate Employee (Take Loan)

request.description: Safe Low-Risk Profile: Stable employee with high savings (100k) and solid income (45k). Low DTI, survives all stress shocks, default probability near 0%, Verdict: TakeLoan.

item.name: Scenario 2: Critical Risk - DTI > 50% & Deficit (Avoid Loan)

request.description: Critical Risk: Low income (9k), low savings (3k), 3 dependents. Total monthly installments exceed 50% DTI limit and wipe out cash flow. Verdict: AvoidLoan.

item.name: Scenario 3: Volatile Freelancer Without Health Insurance (Adjust Terms)

request.description: Moderate/High Risk: Freelancer with volatile income and no insurance. Short 24-month term creates high installment risk under medical or income shock. Verdict: AdjustTerms (extend tenor or build emergency buffer).

item.name: Scenario 4: High Flat Rate Consumer Loan vs Bank Refinance (Take Alternative)

request.description: Consumer Loan Comparison: 16% Flat rate appears deceptively low, but its Effective APR exceeds 28.5%. Recommendation flags cheaper commercial bank reducing rate alternatives (e.g. NBE / Misr at 21.5% saving 15,000+ EGP).

item.name: Scenario 5: Prepayment & Annual Bonus Optimization Plan

request.description: Repayment Strategy Optimization: Simulates accelerated +15% monthly extra payoff vs annual 10% bonus prepayment. Calculates net interest saved after deducting the bank's 3% early settlement penalty, and warns against payment holidays.
